Seaboard System Railroad | The Seaboard System Railroad, Inc. was a short-lived former US Class I railroad that was created after the consolidation of the Family Lines System railroads (notably the Louisville & Nashville, Seaboard Coast Line, and Clinchfield) on December 29, 1982. Pennsylvania Railroad 5550 | Pennsylvania Railroad 5550 is a mainline duplex drive steam locomotive currently under construction in the United States of America.
